functions.abi: __thiscall, ECX = atlas manager 00f8c26c, one stack native-string argument, RET 4, void
functions.behavior: Logs 'Loading atlas: %s' (004254b0). Rejects a path whose lowercased last four bytes are not '.ats' (__stricmp vs 00d5d23c). Directory prefix = max(rfind('\\'), rfind('/')) then substring(0, i+1), fallback './' (00d5d7d0). Enumerates that directory with extension 'ats' (00d5d7cc) through 00886280 on the file system singleton 0109ceec. For each name, 00aef3c0 decides whether it belongs to the request; on acceptance and when the manager's texture array holds no matching entry, 00aef280 registers it. The name array is freed with free at 00af0396.

globals.00f8c270: empty-string sentinel used when the path data pointer is null

functions.container: manager texture array base+0x10, count+0x14, element name string at +8 via 00b33e40 (LEA EAX,[ECX+8]; RET)
functions.quirk: The dedupe loop at 00af02f0 compares registered texture paths against the REQUESTED path (MOV ECX,[EDI] at 00af0305), not against the candidate. Texture paths come from the atlas header and are .dds, so the guard cannot fire for a .ats request.

functions.abi: __fastcall, ECX = requested descriptor string, EDX = candidate string, AL result
functions.behavior: Lowercases both sides and replaces '\\' with '/' (004cad40). Returns true on exact case-insensitive equality. Returns false when the candidate is shorter than the request. Requires rfind('/') to return the same index on both sides and the directory text before it to match. Requires both names to end in '.ats'. Otherwise returns equals_ci(stem(request) + '_', candidate.substr(0, len(request) - 3)); both spans are measured from the request.
functions.effect: One logical atlas request loads every '<stem>_*.ats' sibling.

functions.abi: __fastcall, ECX = foliage system, no stack arguments
functions.behavior: Builds a Lua state and loads Effects\\foliage\\FoliageTypes.lua, pushes the global 'Foliages' and iterates it. Each element has a 'name' field plus indexed sub-entries: a one-based counter (initialised at 00ae87f8) is appended by 004caca0 to eight stems built at 00ae8899..00ae8be4 in the order model, modeltype, percent, uptexture, sidetexture, scale, height, topheight. Per sub-index it takes the model branch when model<N> exists (model, modeltype, percent), the impostor branch when uptexture<N> exists (uptexture, sidetexture, scale, height, topheight, percent), otherwise logs the Hungarian diagnostic and stops.

No .mvfm file exists in the installation and no loose .mpkg, so the vertex-format request path is unverified against real data.

tool_problems: python tools/bsp.py ghidra disasm <addr> omits the function's first instruction. For 00ad71c0 the listing begins at 00ad71c4 and drops MOV AL, byte ptr [ESP+4] at 00ad71c0, which changes how the parameter appears to arrive. bsp.py disasm-raw shows it correctly.

python tools/bsp.py ghidra disasm <addr> --start <hex> rejected addresses inside the function body with 'is not an instruction start', even for real instruction boundaries such as 00af0250 inside 00af0060; paging had to be done by piping the full listing through sed.
The export path printed by ghidra export is relative to the main checkout, so inside a worktree the exports/bsp/functions/<addr>/decompiled.c path only resolves from the main checkout root.
